hubs.name: FedEx World Hub — Memphis
hubs.notes: Primary FedEx sort facility. All FedEx Priority Overnight routes pass through here.

hubs.name: FedEx Hub — Indianapolis
hubs.notes: Major FedEx secondary hub. Critical node for Midwest and East Coast deliveries.

hubs.name: FedEx Hub — Oakland
hubs.notes: West Coast FedEx hub. Key routing point for CA, OR, WA deliveries.

hubs.name: FedEx Hub — Newark
hubs.notes: Northeast FedEx hub serving NY, NJ, CT, MA, and New England.

hubs.name: FedEx Hub — Fort Worth
hubs.notes: South Central FedEx hub serving TX, OK, LA, AR.

hubs.name: FedEx Hub — Miami
hubs.notes: Southeast FedEx hub. Critical for FL deliveries — monitor heat in summer months.

hubs.name: FedEx Hub — Chicago (O'Hare)
hubs.notes: Major Great Lakes FedEx hub. Cold winters — always check Nov–Mar.

hubs.name: FedEx Hub — Phoenix
hubs.notes: Southwest FedEx hub. EXTREME summer heat — mandatory hold-at-facility May through September.

hubs.name: FedEx Hub — Atlanta
hubs.notes: Southeast regional FedEx hub. Hot summers — monitor June through September.

hubs.name: FedEx Hub — Denver
hubs.notes: Mountain West FedEx hub. Rapid temperature swings possible year-round. Monitor closely Oct–Apr.

hubs.name: UPS Worldport — Louisville
hubs.notes: UPS primary world hub. All UPS Next Day Air routes pass through Louisville. Always check Louisville weather.

hubs.name: UPS Hub — Dallas
hubs.notes: South Central UPS hub. Hot summers — hold-at-facility recommended Jun–Sep for heat-sensitive species.

hubs.name: UPS Hub — Ontario (Los Angeles)
hubs.notes: West Coast UPS hub serving Southern CA. Inland temps can be extreme in summer.

hubs.name: UPS Hub — Philadelphia
hubs.notes: Northeast UPS hub. Cold winters — monitor Dec–Mar. Occasional extreme summer heat.

hubs.name: UPS Hub — Chicago
hubs.notes: Great Lakes UPS hub. Severe winter cold — high-risk Nov through Mar for cold-sensitive species.

hubs.name: UPS Hub — Atlanta
hubs.notes: Southeast UPS hub. Warm climate, monitor summer months.

hubs.name: UPS Hub — Seattle
hubs.notes: Pacific Northwest UPS hub. Mild but wet — occasional cold snaps Oct–Mar.

hubs.name: UPS Hub — Miami
hubs.notes: Southeast UPS hub. Year-round heat — crested geckos should rarely ship here in summer.

hubs.name: UPS Hub — Minneapolis
hubs.notes: Upper Midwest UPS hub. Extreme winters — one of the highest-risk hubs Nov through Mar. Use 72-hour heat packs, hold-at-facility mandatory when below 20F.

hubs.name: UPS Hub — Phoenix
hubs.notes: Southwest UPS hub. EXTREME summer heat — no-ship zone for most species Jun–Sep without hold-at-facility.
